# Aronica

> Agent-to-Human dispatch for Milano: the physical step of an agentic flow. Personal assistants book home services (gardening, furniture assembly, handyman, cleaning, waiting at home for a technician or courier, errands with purchase); company agents hire one-shot staff (load-in crews and event staff at Fiera Rho and MiCo, short-let turnover, photo inspections, retail checks). Verified partners, fixed prices, guaranteed replacement on no-show.

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): /mcp with Authorization: Bearer <api key> (demo: ak_demo_milano personal, ak_demo_business company)
- REST: /v1, OpenAPI 3.1 at /openapi.json
- OpenAI/xAI function schemas: /v1/tools.json
- Human-readable guide: /docs

Flow: compile_task (structured job, fixed price, open questions) -> create_job -> negotiate | auto_negotiate (A2A on WHEN, never on price) -> accept_quote -> consumer: human confirms via confirm_url; company: auto-approved under policy -> wait_for_update -> get_job (seats, contracts, proof, invoice) -> rate_worker.

Out of scope, other cities, or no available verified partners fail closed with: "Siamo spiacenti ma al momento non abbiamo persone sufficienti a soddisfare la richiesta."
